provenance.notes: Fault-free twin: G-STOP-L-01. The first entry order (the market buy at the open of 280) is executed by the exchange at 100 x 1.0002 = 100.02 for qty 5, but the request times out with no answer. AUD-03 contract: an order known by its client id is resolved only from the exchange's final order record (never inferred, never re-sent while unresolved), protection follows the resolved quantity. Resolution is bounded to minutes, long before candle 282, so the outcome is the twin's: one LONG lot of 5 from 280, its 98.02 stop filled in 282 at 98.000396, STOP_HIT, R -1.059307099, final lots 0. A second entry (double size) or an untracked position would fail it. Deterministic: seed null.
